outcomes.detail: Rd8+ forces checkmate in two. It gives check, and their king on g8 is shut in by its own pawns on f7, g7 and h7, so it has no square to step to. That is a back-rank mate. Next time, when their king is boxed in by its own pawns, look at every check on the last rank first.
